steps.prompt: Their LD waits at the point on your side. Tap the point.

fb.right: That is the point: just below our blue line, near the wall. When they attack, a defender waits there for a pass.
fb.close: Nearly. The point is right below our blue line, by the wall, where their LD is standing.
fb.wrong: The point is higher up, just below our blue line, near the wall. Look for their LD.

fb.right: That is the slot: the ice in front of our net, between the two circles. Most goals are scored from here.
fb.close: Nearly. The slot is straight in front of our net, between the two circles.
fb.wrong: The slot is the ice straight in front of our net, between the two faceoff circles.

steps.prompt: Tap the high slot, the top of the slot.

fb.right: That is the high slot: the top of the slot, toward the blue line. A shot from here still has a short way to our net.
fb.close: Nearly. The high slot is the top of the slot, near the top of the two circles.
fb.wrong: The high slot is in the middle of the ice, at the top of the two circles, between our net and the blue line.

steps.prompt: Tap your wall at the hash marks.

fb.right: That is your wall at the hash marks. When we win the puck, a winger waits here for the pass out.
fb.close: Nearly. Right on the wall, beside the short lines next to the circle.
fb.wrong: Your wall is the right-hand side of the rink. The hash marks are the short lines beside the circle.

steps.prompt: Tap our blue line, in the middle of the ice.

fb.right: That is our blue line, the edge of our zone. A breakout ends when the puck crosses it.
fb.close: Nearly. The blue line is the thick line nearest the middle of the rink.
fb.wrong: Our blue line is the thick line that marks the edge of our zone, above the points.
